changes.summary: the icon set, rendered from the product's own motif (a page with a highlight swept across a line and a presence dot) on the off-black ground.
names the three icons (any 192/512 + maskable 512), adds id, lang, dir and categories.
appleWebApp (capable, title, status bar) and the icon/apple-touch-icon links; formatDetection off.
a designed offline page (static, so Serwist can precache it), with a Try again link.
additionalPrecacheEntries: ['/w', '/~offline'] — documents are not in the build's asset manifest.
navigation preload disabled (explicitly, on activate — Serwist never disables it) and navigateFallback '/w' with a denylist, so an offline deep link renders the shell.

decisions: Navigation preload off: it can hand a navigation a failed preload response offline, and Serwist never turns it back off.
navigateFallback to the shell, not the offline page: the app is client-rendered, so the shell + its router is correct for any path (and renders the workspace offline from Dexie).
Precache the shell and the offline page explicitly, because `fallbacks` does not add them.
Icons are generated from the in-app motif rather than shipping a placeholder.
